Name: Renew and Deploy SSL Certificates
Description:
Task Owner: Ben

- Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com before its expiration on September 1st, with a target completion date of August 22nd.
- Deploy the renewed SSL certificate to the load balancers.
- Set up auto-renewal for the SSL certificates using cert-manager to prevent annual manual renewals.
- Additionally, rotate the internal CA certificate for the service mesh during the same change window, as it expires two weeks after the public SSL certificate.

Name: Implement PDF Export Feature for Reports
Description:
Task Owner: Aisha

- Develop backend functionality to render reports to PDF using headless Chrome.
- Implement frontend functionality including an export button and a progress indicator for large reports.
- Target completion by the end of the month.
- Record a short demo GIF of the export feature for the marketing changelog upon completion.

Name: Ensure Staging Environment Parity with Production
Description:
Task Owner: Ben

- Write a nightly job to compare the schema of the staging environment against production.
- Post alerts to the infra channel if there are any divergences between staging and production schemas.
- Apply the current pending migrations to the staging environment to bring it in line with production.
